limits: This is an iOS-only source selection, not a full multi-platform repository export.
App Store binary distribution permission under current terms remains unresolved in the separate rights review; source publication alone does not resolve that question.
Source bytes and modes are verified; native rebuild and byte-identical binary reproduction are not claimed.
Later privacy or metadata source changes require a new snapshot and new archive hash; they are not retroactively included in this candidate.
App Store distribution/licence compatibility, final export/privacy answers and physical playback remain separate gates.
